title: After working in various gyms for years I finally made a game that lets you build your own dream gym! Made with opus 5.5 as the driver, and Astra as the agent
author: mrjbelfort
selftext:
I work in the fitness industry as a trainer/ strength coach and have been in and out of many different gyms in my career. I always wanted to build my own gym in something like the sims, but it’s just not possible to the level I wanted to take it. 

So, over the past couple of months I have developed my dream gym. I started working on it when Astra released, and it will be [launching soon on steam!](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5407530/My_Dream_Gym_Sandbox/?beta=0)

However, the problem I ran into with Astra was how long it would take to build each model. There are sooooo many different types of machines and equipment that I wanted to build with, and each one took Astra several hours. 

So what I did is set up a workflow that gives Claude access to run codex through the cli. This way Claude can set up the plan, and let Astra execute it as an ‘agent’. Claude can then check the work done by Astra, and either send it back for edits or approve it. 

This way Astra is running literally 24-7 building models, staying in context. Meanwhile Claude has no context issues since it’s just cli prompts and small pre rendered image files that it’s looking at. It’s like a symbiotic ai relationship but it works really well. I am happy to go into more details about the workflow here if anyone is curious!
